D: Marty and Doc jump to 2015 to save Marty's future kids, then have to fix 1985.
P: Serve the mains when Lorraine puts the tiny pizza in the hydrator.
S: Spiralized potatoes fried crisp, tossed with smoked paprika salt
Curly fries: potatoes cut on a spiraliser, soaked 30 minutes, dried well, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in smoked paprika salt.
fifty years of results in one book

Crisp parmesan and rosemary crackers rolled thin and cut into little book shapes, baked golden and served with a fig and onion jam. Rub 60g cold butter into 120g plain flour, then mix in 80g finely grated parmesan, 1 tsp chopped rosemary and a pinch of salt. Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to bring it together and chill 20 minutes. Roll 3mm thick and cut into 4 by 6cm rectangles. Score a line down the middle of each like a book spine. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Serve with fig jam.
Pink beetroot dusted tortilla chips with fresh guacamole
Flour tortillas cut into board shapes, fried at 180C, tossed in salt and beetroot powder for colour, guacamole.
M: Thin crust pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni
Bake mini pizzas for the reveal, then serve a full-size New York pie: thin sauce, low-moisture mozzarella and pepperoni on a hot steel at max heat.
Biff's Paradise steak and lobster mac

Rib eye seared and butter-basted with peppercorn sauce, beside a gooey cheddar macaroni with butter-poached lobster folded through. Salt 4 rib eye steaks the night before. Cook 300g macaroni. Melt 40g butter, stir in 40g flour, whisk in 600ml milk and cook until thick, then add 200g cheddar and the pasta. Poach 2 raw lobster tails, cut into chunks, in 60g butter for 4 minutes and fold through. Sear the steaks 3 minutes a side, basting with butter, and rest 8 minutes. Add 2 tbsp brandy, 1 tbsp cracked pepper and 150ml cream to the pan and reduce.
W: Blue jelly with gummy sharks, topped with whipped cream waves
Blue jelly set in glasses with gummy sharks suspended halfway, whipped cream waves on top.
K: Strawberry ice cream, fresh strawberries and milk blended thick
Strawberry milkshake: 3 scoops strawberry ice cream, fresh strawberries and milk blended thick.

dishes.make_ahead: Fries can be soaked up to 4 hours ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Spiralise the potatoes and soak in cold water so the starch rinses out.
Drain and dry very well on clean tea towels, any water will spit in the oil.
Heat the oil to 180C and fry in batches until crisp and golden.
Mix the salt with the smoked paprika, toss through the hot fries and serve straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Chips up to 1 day, airtight. Guacamole best made just before

steps.text: Cut the tortillas into hoverboard shapes with a knife or template.
Heat the oil to 180C and fry the shapes in batches until crisp, then drain on paper towel.
Toss the hot chips with salt and the beetroot powder until pink.
Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt to make the guacamole. Serve with the chips.
Heat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza steel or heavy tray inside.
Top the mini bases with a little sauce and cheese and bake for the reveal.
Stretch the dough as thin as you can and spread with the crushed tomatoes.
Scatter over the mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat until the crust blisters and the cheese bubbles.
Heat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza steel or heavy tray inside.
Toss the mushrooms with the olive oil, smoked paprika and chilli flakes.
Top the mini bases with a little of the crushed tomatoes and mozzarella and bake for the reveal.
Stretch the dough as thin as you can and spread with the rest of the crushed tomatoes.
Scatter over the remaining mozzarella and the spiced mushrooms.
Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat until the crust blisters and the cheese bubbles.
Dissolve the jelly crystals in the boiling water, then stir in the cold water.
Pour halfway into four glasses and chill until just starting to set.
Push the gummy sharks in, top up with the rest of the jelly and chill until fully set.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and spoon on top as waves.
Bring the lemonade, sugar and agar to the boil, simmer for 2 minutes, then stir in the colouring.
Pour half into four glasses and chill until just set. Keep the rest warm over very low heat.
Push the gummy sharks in, top up with the rest of the jelly and chill until fully set.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and spoon on top as waves.

dishes.make_ahead: Make one after the other so they stay thick

steps.text: Chill four tall glasses in the freezer.
Blend each shake in turn with its ice cream, strawberries and milk until thick.
Pour into the chilled glasses and add a straw.

edition.cue: Serve the mains when Lorraine puts the tiny pizza in the hydrator.

s.note: Spiral curly fries with smoked paprika salt
s.how: Spiralise 4 large potatoes and soak in cold water for 30 minutes. Dry very well on tea towels. Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and golden. Toss with fine salt mixed with 1 tsp smoked paprika and serve hot.

s.note: Pink hoverboard tortilla chips with guacamole
s.how: Cut 6 flour tortillas into hoverboard shapes. Fry at 180C until crisp and toss with salt and 1 tsp beetroot powder for a pink colour. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of a lime and salt for guacamole.

m.note: Thin New York pepperoni pizza after a quick mini pizza reveal
m.how: Bake 4 mini pizza bases with sauce and cheese for the reveal. Then stretch 500g dough thin, spread with 200g crushed tomatoes, add 250g low-moisture mozzarella and 100g pepperoni, and bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

w.note: Blue jelly with gummy sharks swimming in it
w.how: Make 2 packets blue jelly crystals with 500ml boiling and 500ml cold water. Pour halfway into four glasses and chill until just starting to set. Push in gummy sharks, add the rest of the jelly and set. Top with whipped cream waves.

d.note: Thick strawberry milkshake with fresh strawberries
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops strawberry ice cream with 4 strawberries and 150ml cold milk until thick. Pour into a tall chilled glass with a straw. Make four one after the other so they stay thick.
